# SayPulse AI Voice Feedback Platform — Complete Technical Knowledge Base

**Entity:** NextGen Multiverse Enterprises Pvt Ltd  
**Domain:** `https://saypulse.nextgenmultiverse.com`  
**License:** Enterprise SaaS & Proprietary SDK  

---

## 1. Architectural Overview

SayPulse operates as a decoupled client-server platform:
1. **Client Layer:** Zero-dependency standalone script (`saypulse.min.js`) encapsulating an interactive microphone badge, Canvas waveform visualizers, star rating controls, and automatic technical context harvesting in an open Shadow DOM root.
2. **AI Processing Layer:** Express API gateway with Google Gemini 3.6 Flash multimodal models that ingest sanitized transcripts and generate structured JSON outputs (Summary, Category, Task, Sentiment, 4 Tone Rewrites).
3. **Authentication Layer:** NextGen WhatsApp Web Gateway (`wa.nextgenmultiverse.com`) that delivers 6-digit OTP codes directly to user WhatsApp numbers.
4. **Data Isolation Layer:** Multi-tenant relational data model guaranteeing zero data leakage between customer workspaces (`/admin/[slug]`).

---

## 2. Integration Quickstart (1-Line Embed)

Place this script before `</body>` on any HTML, React, Next.js, Shopify, WordPress, or PHP webpage:

```html
<script 
  src="https://saypulse.nextgenmultiverse.com/saypulse.min.js" 
  data-key="sp_live_your_company_api_key" 
  data-position="bottom-right" 
  data-color="#06B6D4" 
  data-animation="siri-wave"
  data-trigger-style="minimal-pill"
  data-auto-collapse="true"
  defer>
</script>
```

---

## 3. Data Governance & Privacy Invariants

- **DPDP Act 2023 Compliant:** No raw audio recordings are stored on persistent storage.
- **Client-Side Redaction:** Payment cards, phone numbers, and emails are scrubbed before LLM dispatch.
- **Encryption:** TLS 1.3 in-transit and salted SHA-256 for credentials.
- **Enterprise 99.99% SLA:** Edge CDN delivery with < 1.5s median synthesis latency.
